policy.scope: Authored signal implementation test, not real-speech or deployed-provider accuracy validation.
policy.device: CPUfloat32, frozen generator/detector, two Torch threads, no serving imports.
policy.sources: Four8s16kHz mono carriers: harmonic pulses, speech-shaped noise pulses, chirp mixture, silence. Seed20261108.
policy.mark: Fixed alternating16bit message; full or source samples32000:96000 only. Unmarked samples outside partial span must be bit-identical.
policy.noise: Same white-noise realization at10dB relative to carrier RMS, floor.001; no watermark added to negative controls.
policy.mp3: 64kbps seekable MP3, decoded16kHzfloat32; exact sample-count preservation required, no hidden alignment trimming/padding.
policy.readout: Native per-sample watermark response, strict>0.5; quarter-second bins selected only when more than half their samples exceed0.5. Preserve sample coordinates.
policy.parity: Four high-level helper fractions/bits match direct native outputs (fraction tolerance1e-7); first marked native response repeats bit-exactly.
policy.identity: No provider/creator authentication, AI confidence contribution or detection early stop from this public-family response.
